notes.text: The page carries conditions a)–d) for the graph-morphism data: a surjection on vertices and a bijection on the indicated oriented-edge set; commuting squares; a fibre subgraph with its marked-point map and genus map; rigidity conditions; and a final genus-sum formula. The text is heavily revised. The last cardinality term of the main rigidity inequality is present and altered from B to C, with a cancelled alpha index; it must not be omitted as in H’s displayed formula. Two crossed lower inequalities, marginal weight/degree explanations and all cancellation candidates are preserved. The handwritten heading is 19 and the faint footer is 39.

The author writes tous before conditions, repeats the alpha index on the membership-set B prime alpha in the NB, and uses unprimed G(alpha) in both parts of d), although c) introduces G prime(alpha). These are retained as ink, without grammatical or mathematical repair. The page’s assertions were transcribed, not proved.

A previously unencoded card I beta-like fragment lies below and left of the right marginal bracket, overlapping the strike network of the lower block. It is offered only as an uncertain deleted fragment: letter/prime details, cancellation state and attachment remain open for main and blind review. The isolated map label g prime also has an f-like transverse stroke, so a g prime/f prime doubt was added. No certainty is inferred from agreement between C and H.

coverage.differences_accounted: Every packet difference was examined against both witnesses and ink. Scan metadata, H editorial notes, LaTeX/TikZ coordinates, spacing, tilde/widetilde, emph/underline, struck/deleted and sqcup/amalg conventions are not independent content rows. Actual extra prose in H, graph-prime states, placement, words, punctuation, abbreviations, missing marginal/cancelled matter and the omitted last cardinality term are logged. All 27 saved crops were visually inspected. The final raised-stroke check confirms that the apparent superscript over l’extrémité is the end of the sloping NB’s G prime(alpha), already included in that note; it is not a new insertion into the main word. The seven decisions follow MARKS order; twenty nested C doubts are separately recorded.
